notes: SCANR approvals: your exported approvals import even after SCANR has already scanned, and merge with any made in CLOSR. SCANR and TRACKR in sync: SCANR runs in the background and TRACKR shows its BOL/Loaded/Unloaded/POD verdicts live (with notices when paperwork lands); uploads rescan right away; recently delivered loads appear in TRACKR. TRACKR shows who in carrier sales is working a locked uncovered load, and every status has its own color. Task due dates no longer reset to today (new Today button). Emails show progress and clear errors in the composer (including Outlook not connected). Deleted contacts no longer reappear as 'saved'. Notices now float on top of everything. Search bars match CLOSR's look.
